meta.description: Write competitive research proposals for NSF, NIH, DOE, DARPA, and Taiwan NSTC. Agency-specific formatting, review criteria, budget preparation, broader impacts, significance statements, innovation narratives, and compliance with submission requirements. Includes comprehensive reference documentation covering all proposal components.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated funding data or success rates; accurate representation of agency requirements

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for grant writing assistance with clear disclaimers about institution-specific compliance

methodological_ground.detail: Based on official agency guidelines (NSF PAPPG 24-1, NIH formats, etc.)

code_usability.detail: No code generation in this writing-focused skill

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of 5 major agencies (NSF, NIH, DOE, DARPA, NSTC) with all standard proposal components

reliability.note: Excellent reliability with explicit review criteria mapping, common mistakes documentation, agency-specific requirements

performance_context.note: Well-organized with 10 reference files totaling 5180 lines, clear agency overview table, component documentation

agent_usability.note: Outstanding with When to Use section, agency-specific features tables, review criteria cross-reference, writing principles

human_usability.note: Clear guidance structure, optional figure integration via scientific-schematics skill, worked examples in references

security.note: Good security with API disclosure for optional figure generation; minor: no explicit PII handling guidance for biosketches

maintainability.note: Version 1.2, MIT license, dated reference to NSF PAPPG 24-1, clear agency mission statements

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with scientific-schematics skill integration, clear trigger (grant writing); minor: escape hatch for institution-specific compliance not explicit

key_strengths: Comprehensive multi-agency coverage with detailed requirements for NSF, NIH, DOE, DARPA, and Taiwan NSTC
Exceptional reference organization with 5180 lines covering core components, review criteria, writing principles, and proposal types
Outstanding agency-specific guidance with mission statements, key features tables, and review criteria mapping
Strong integration with scientific-schematics skill for optional figure generation with clear API disclosure
Excellent common mistakes documentation covering both conceptual and writing errors

recommendations.title: Add explicit PII handling guidance for biosketches
recommendations.problem: Biosketches contain sensitive personal information but handling not explicitly addressed
recommendations.root_cause: Security criterion not fully met for PII in grant documents
recommendations.fix: Add to ## Core Components or new ## Data Security section: 'Biosketches and CVs contain PII. Store securely, do not include SSNs, and follow institution's data classification policy.'

recommendations.title: Add institution-specific compliance escape hatch
recommendations.problem: Budget indirect rates and some compliance items are institution-specific
recommendations.root_cause: Agent-specific 'escape hatch' criterion not fully addressed
recommendations.fix: Add prominent note: 'This skill provides general agency guidance. For institution-specific indirect rates, cost-sharing policies, and compliance requirements, consult your sponsored projects office.'

recommendations.title: Emphasize resubmission response strategy in main doc
recommendations.problem: Resubmission guidance exists in references but not prominent
recommendations.root_cause: Critical success factor (addressing reviewer critiques) not elevated
recommendations.fix: Add to ## Common Mistakes to Avoid: 'Resubmission Mistake: Failing to directly address each reviewer critique with a point-by-point response in the introduction (see references/proposal_types_and_resubmission.md).'
